trend.zh: 本周AI项目聚焦于模型更新与开发者工具，特别是在自然语言处理和图像生成领域。DeepSeek、谷歌和Cerebras等公司发布了新的模型或技术预览，显示出对提高模型性能和效率的持续关注。同时，社区内关于开放性和伦理问题的讨论也在增加。
trend.en: This week, AI projects are focused on model updates and developer tools, particularly in natural language processing and image generation. Companies like DeepSeek, Google, and Cerebras have released new models or technology previews, showing a continued emphasis on improving model performance and efficiency. Meanwhile, discussions around openness and ethics within the community are also on the rise.

deep.zh:
本周AI领域的风向明显朝向了模型迭代与技术创新，尤其是针对自然语言处理和图像生成的应用。DeepSeek发布V4 Pro 0813版本以及其Harness开发者预览版，为开发人员提供了更多可能性。与此同时，谷歌推出了Gemini 3.7 Flash模型，强调了在速度和准确性上的改进。此外，Cerebras加速GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast模型进一步展示了硬件加速对于模型训练的重要性。

值得注意的是，马克·扎克伯格批评封闭式AI竞争对手的行为引起了广泛关注，这表明行业内对于开放性与透明度的需求正在增长。另一方面，甲骨文禁止OpenJDK中使用AI生成代码的规定，则引发了关于AI伦理及其实用性的讨论。这些趋势共同指向了一个更加注重协作与责任的未来方向。

代表项目方面，arXiv上多个高分研究论文如2608.13558v1（总分21）探讨了先进的算法优化方法；而Hugging Face空间中的MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-Music3（总分18）则展现了音乐生成领域的最新进展。展望下周，预计将继续看到围绕模型创新、开源合作以及伦理考量方面的动态发展。
deep.en:
The trend this week in the AI domain is clearly moving towards model iteration and technological innovation, especially for applications in natural language processing and image generation. DeepSeek's release of V4 Pro 0813 version and its Harness Developer Preview has opened up more possibilities for developers. At the same time, Google's launch of the Gemini 3.7 Flash model emphasizes improvements in speed and accuracy. Furthermore, Cerebras' acceleration of the GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast model further demonstrates the importance of hardware acceleration for model training.

Notably, Mark Zuckerberg's criticism of closed AI competitors has garnered significant attention, indicating a growing demand for openness and transparency within the industry. On another note, Oracle's ban on using AI-generated code in OpenJDK has sparked discussions about AI ethics and practicality. These trends collectively point towards a future direction that places greater emphasis on collaboration and responsibility.

In terms of representative projects, several high-scoring research papers on arXiv such as 2608.13558v1 (total score 21) explore advanced algorithm optimization methods; while Hugging Face space's MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-Music3 (total score 18) showcases the latest developments in music generation. Looking ahead to next week, it is expected that we will continue to see dynamic developments surrounding model innovation, open-source collaboration, and ethical considerations.

summary.en: Google has released the new Gemini 3.7 Flash model, the latest addition to its multimodal AI lineup, designed to deliver faster and more accurate results.

summary.en: DeepSeek has announced the release of its latest version, V4 Pro 0813, which promises to deliver enhanced features and improved user experience for their upgraded AI assistant.

summary.en: Cerebras, in collaboration with OpenAI, has significantly boosted the performance of the GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast model using its hardware acceleration technology.

summary.zh: 马克·扎克伯格公开批评了所谓的“封闭”AI竞争对手，并表示Meta将回归开放模型路线。
summary.en: Mark Zuckerberg publicly criticized so-called 'closed' AI rivals and stated that Meta would return to the path of open models.

news.name: Mark Zuckerberg attacks 'closed' AI rivals as Meta returns to open models

title.zh: DeepSeek Harness开发者预览版发布

summary.zh: DeepSeek推出了Harness平台的开发者预览版，这是一个旨在简化AI模型训练和部署过程的新工具。
summary.en: DeepSeek has launched the developer preview of Harness, a new platform aimed at simplifying the process of training and deploying AI models.

title.zh: NeurIPS会议没有一个关于因果关系的工作坊
title.en: No Causality Workshops at NeurIPS Conference

summary.zh: 今年的NeurIPS大会共有73个工作坊，却没有一个是专门讨论因果关系的。这引发了对因果推断领域当前地位的关注。
summary.en: This year's NeurIPS conference features 73 workshops, but none are dedicated to causality. This raises concerns about the current status of the field of causal inference.

news.name: 73 NeurIPS workshops, and not a single one on Causality [R]

title.zh: 甲骨文禁止OpenJDK中使用AI生成代码
title.en: Oracle Bans AI-Generated Code from OpenJDK

summary.zh: 甲骨文宣布禁止在OpenJDK项目中使用AI生成的代码，尽管埃里森声称甲骨文不会自己编写代码。
summary.en: Oracle has announced a ban on AI-generated code in the OpenJDK project, despite Ellison's claim that Oracle isn't writing its own code.

news.name: Oracle bans AI-generated code from OpenJDK

overview.zh: 本周AI建设者们在X上的发言涵盖了从模型安全到用户体验的多个方面，展示了AI技术的最新进展和挑战。讨论的重点包括提高AI系统的安全性、优化用户与AI交互的方式以及构建更有效的开发流程。
overview.en: This week, AI builders on X covered a wide range of topics from model security to user experience, showcasing the latest advancements and challenges in AI technology. The discussions highlighted improving AI system security, optimizing user interactions with AI, and building more effective development workflows.

summary.zh: 多位发言者强调了提高AI系统安全性的重要性，特别是在对抗恶意攻击和确保用户数据隐私方面。Boris Cherny提到Anthropic已经解决了Claude模型中的提示注入问题，而Thariq则介绍了Claude生成文本的嵌入式水印功能。
summary.en: Several speakers emphasized the importance of enhancing AI system security, particularly against malicious attacks and ensuring user data privacy. Boris Cherny mentioned that Anthropic has largely solved the prompt injection issue in Claude models, while Thariq introduced embedded watermarking for Claude-generated text.

quotes.author: Boris Cherny
quotes.text: At Anthropic we have been training our models not to fall for these kinds of attacks, and the results have been surprisingly positive. We have largely solved the threat of prompt injection in practice when using Claude models.

quotes.author: Thariq
quotes.text: All Claude generated text will have this embedded watermarking. For example, you could check if a PR was generated by Claude Code. That said, it does have limitations.

summary.zh: 改善用户体验是本周讨论的一个重要主题。Peter Yang分享了如何通过语音控制云代理来改变我们使用计算机的方式，而Zara Zhang则提供了一种利用Codex分析网站设计的方法。
summary.en: Improving user experience was a key topic this week. Peter Yang shared how voice control of cloud agents can change the way we use computers, while Zara Zhang provided a method for using Codex to analyze website design.

quotes.author: Peter Yang
quotes.text: We’re moving from doing work manually with a keyboard, mouse, and laptop to directing agents in the cloud using our voices. In my new essay, I cover why: 1. Voice is becoming the orchestration layer 2. Personal computers will move to the cloud 3. Trust will be the key differentiator

quotes.author: Zara Zhang
quotes.text: A great way to learn design: Give Codex a well-designed website, ask it to analyze what makes the design great, then ask it to take a complete screenshot of the website & add annotations on the image that breaks down why the design works

summary.zh: 几位发言者讨论了如何优化开发流程以提高效率。Swyx提出了删除不必要的技能以减少上下文负担的建议，而Guillermo Rauch则强调了代码审查的重要性。
summary.en: Several speakers discussed optimizing development workflows for increased efficiency. Swyx suggested deleting unnecessary skills to reduce context burden, while Guillermo Rauch emphasized the importance of code review.

quotes.author: Swyx
quotes.text: occasional reminder to DELETE your skills. when you are bombarded constantly by 'this skill changed my life!! you have to try!!' on the timeline, you will pile up stuff that at best just eats context, and at worst interacts with other skills nastily in unforeseen ways if you dont stare at your traces.

quotes.author: Guillermo Rauch
quotes.text: “Did you deepsec it?” “@𝚟 can you deepsec” “/𝚍𝚎𝚎𝚙𝚜𝚎𝚌” It’s a bit like /𝚝𝚑𝚎𝚛𝚖𝚘-𝚗𝚞𝚌𝚕𝚎𝚊𝚛-𝚌𝚘𝚍𝚎-𝚚𝚞𝚊𝚕𝚒𝚝𝚢-𝚛𝚎𝚟𝚒𝚎𝚠 but for the security of your code. Must have in your software factory.

trend.zh: 本周AI项目集中在视频编辑、图像处理及软件开发自动化领域，体现了AI技术在这些领域的深入应用。Qwen3.8-Max的发布为编码与协作树立了新标准，同时也有研究表明AI能够提供高质量的财务建议。
trend.en: This week, AI projects are clustered around video editing, image processing, and software development automation, reflecting deeper integration of AI in these fields. The release of Qwen3.8-Max sets a new standard for coding and collaboration, while studies also show that AI can provide high-quality financial advice.

deep.zh: 本周AI项目的趋势明显指向了创意工具和生产力增强方向。在视频编辑方面，如JoyAI-Video-Edit等项目展现了通过AI简化复杂编辑任务的能力；图像处理上，多个Hugging Face空间项目如Onise/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-LoRAs-Fast2提供了强大的图像生成与修改功能。软件开发自动化则成为另一大热点，诸如Binaryify/open-kimi-ppt-skill这样的项目致力于通过AI提高开发效率。值得注意的是，尽管AI在许多正面应用中展现出巨大潜力，但也暴露出一些问题，比如Meta投放含有不当内容的广告事件提醒我们在利用AI时必须保持警惕，并确保其使用符合伦理规范。此外，随着Oracle禁止OpenJDK使用AI生成代码的规定出台，未来如何平衡技术创新与版权保护将成为一个重要议题。下周值得关注的是更多关于AI安全性和责任性的讨论，以及是否有新的创新解决方案出现来解决当前面临的挑战。
deep.en: The trend this week clearly points towards creative tools and productivity enhancement. In video editing, projects like JoyAI-Video-Edit demonstrate the ability to simplify complex editing tasks through AI; in image processing, several Hugging Face spaces such as Onise/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-LoRAs-Fast2 offer powerful image generation and modification capabilities. Software development automation has become another major focus, with projects like Binaryify/open-kimi-ppt-skill aiming to increase development efficiency through AI. It's worth noting that while AI shows great potential in many positive applications, it also exposes some issues - the incident of Meta placing ads containing inappropriate content serves as a reminder that we must remain vigilant and ensure its use is ethical. Furthermore, with Oracle's ban on using AI-generated code in OpenJDK, balancing technological innovation with copyright protection will be an important topic moving forward. Next week, more discussions about AI safety and accountability, as well as any new innovative solutions addressing current challenges, are worth watching.

news.name: Software development with AI is starting to feel like cooking steak

overview.zh: 本周，AI 建设者们在 X 上分享了关于 AI 技术的最新进展、应用场景及对未来影响的观点。讨论涵盖了从 AI 在企业中的应用到个人代理的发展等多个方面。
overview.en: This week, AI builders on X shared insights on the latest advancements, applications, and future impacts of AI technology. Discussions ranged from AI in enterprise to the development of personal agents.

summary.zh: 多位发言者探讨了 AI 在企业中的实际应用，包括自动化流程、提高效率以及改变工作方式等。
summary.en: Several speakers discussed the practical applications of AI in enterprises, including automating processes, improving efficiency, and transforming work methods.

quotes.author: Aaron Levie
quotes.text: We’re going to be in for a strange dynamic which is that some of the “hardest” work in the world is actually prone to automation first, particularly due to its verifiability.

quotes.author: Guillermo Rauch
quotes.text: We built an agent that powers our company's internal operations called @𝚟. Every day-to-day job at Vercel now involves @𝚟. It's growing exponentially both in daily interactions and token use.

quotes.author: Amjad Masad
quotes.text: Airtable bookends the rise and fall of “no code.” I remember arguing endlessly with investors about this. UI can never let you build arbitrary software. The way to make software accessible was always to solve code itself.

summary.zh: 讨论集中在如何通过个人代理改善用户体验，以及这些代理如何在日常生活中发挥作用。
summary.en: The discussion focused on how personal agents can improve user experience and how these agents function in everyday life.

quotes.author: Peter Yang
quotes.text: Personality matters! A smart friend that's annoying to talk to is no good.

quotes.author: Garry Tan
quotes.text: Here's what I think you need to know about personal AGI - not a chatbot that anyone can have, but one that knows you uniquely, now and into the future

quotes.author: Thibault Sottiaux
quotes.text: You can just ask Codex with GPT-5.6 Sol the wildest things and it will just do it. I talk to it for 5 minutes straight with things that just seem to require weeks of work, get up to get something in the fridge, pet the dog, come back and ... it's done.

summary.zh: 发言者们讨论了 AI 技术的进步对社会的影响，包括道德、经济和文化等方面。
summary.en: Speakers discussed the impact of AI technological advancements on society, including ethical, economic, and cultural aspects.

quotes.author: Dan Shipper
quotes.text: if ought implies can, and technology reshapes the field of human abilities—then technology reshapes oughts. we should expect AI to fundamentally change our moral intuitions at the same time as it changes our abilities

quotes.author: Zara Zhang
quotes.text: Contrary to popular perception, most people will not adopt a new technology just because it makes them more efficient. Instead, they’ll adopt new technology because: - Someone they know who’s similar to them on some dimension adopted the technology, and got positive results (eg became cooler, richer, more popular/respected), and they wanna become like that person - They feel like everyone around them has adopted the technology, and if they don’t, they’ll be left behind

quotes.author: Sam Altman
quotes.text: i would rather be an optimist and work hard than a pessimist posting about why things won't work. it's much more difficult and the most likely path is failure, but society fails if people don't try. no amount of "it will never work" essays will drive society forward.

trend.zh: 本周AI项目中，图像处理与生成、自然语言处理和金融分析成为热门主题。尤其在图像编辑与生成领域，多个项目如Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO-Loras-Experimental-neo、ForzaHorizon6-VisionAI等受到关注。此外，涉及金融数据分析的ai-stock-pool也表现不俗。
trend.en: This week, AI projects focused on image processing and generation, natural language processing, and financial analysis. Particularly in the area of image editing and generation, several projects such as Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO-Loras-Experimental-neo and ForzaHorizon6-VisionAI have gained attention. Additionally, ai-stock-pool, which deals with financial data analysis, also showed a strong performance.

deep.zh:
从整体来看，本周AI项目的趋势集中在视觉技术的应用上，尤其是图像编辑、生成以及增强现实领域。其中，QwenAudio/qwen-audio-agent展示了将音频处理与AI相结合的新方法，而Ayin1412/ForzaHorizon6-VisionAI则探索了游戏内视觉AI的可能性。另外，在自然语言处理方面，尽管没有特别突出的项目，但整体上仍保持了一定的关注度。金融分析类项目，例如yaoleifly/ai-stock-pool，通过利用机器学习预测股市走势吸引了投资者的兴趣。

值得注意的是，虽然本周出现了不少高质量的项目，但相较于前几周，在创新性和影响力方面略显平淡。这可能表明当前阶段，研究者们更多地是在现有技术基础上进行改进而非开辟全新领域。未来一周可以重点关注是否有突破性进展出现，特别是在跨模态理解和更复杂场景下的应用开发上。
deep.en:
Overall, this week's trend in AI projects is concentrated on the application of visual technologies, particularly in image editing, generation, and augmented reality. Among them, QwenAudio/qwen-audio-agent demonstrates a new approach to combining audio processing with AI, while Ayin1412/ForzaHorizon6-VisionAI explores the possibilities of in-game visual AI. In the field of natural language processing, although there were no particularly outstanding projects, it still maintained a certain level of attention overall. Financial analysis projects, such as yaoleifly/ai-stock-pool, attracted investor interest by using machine learning to predict stock market trends.

It's worth noting that although many high-quality projects emerged this week, they seemed somewhat less innovative and impactful compared to previous weeks. This might indicate that researchers are currently focusing more on improving existing technologies rather than pioneering entirely new areas. In the coming week, it will be interesting to see if any breakthroughs occur, especially in cross-modal understanding and the development of applications for more complex scenarios.

overview.zh: 本周，AI 建设者们分享了关于 AI 在实际应用中的进展、安全性和未来潜力的观点。从产品开发到企业采用，再到个人生产力的提升，AI 正在逐步改变我们的工作和生活方式。
overview.en: This week, AI builders shared insights on the progress, security, and future potential of AI in real-world applications. From product development to enterprise adoption and personal productivity, AI is gradually transforming how we work and live.

title.zh: AI 的实际应用与影响
title.en: Real-World Applications and Impact of AI

summary.zh: 本周讨论集中在 AI 如何在日常生活中发挥作用，特别是在提高工作效率和个人生产力方面。此外，还探讨了 AI 在不同行业中的应用以及对企业的潜在影响。
summary.en: This week's discussions focused on how AI can be used in daily life, particularly in enhancing work efficiency and personal productivity. Additionally, there was a focus on AI applications across various industries and their potential impact on businesses.

quotes.author: Thibault Sottiaux
quotes.text: Let ChatGPT *work* for you. How many time have you wanted to negotiate your internet bill, get rid of all those spam emails you’re subscribed to, or find the perfect deal for something you wanted to do or buy. It’s quite literally just one prompt away, all from the comfort of your phone. It does at least 20 things for me every single day and I’m still surprised.

quotes.author: Sam Altman
quotes.text: chatgpt work is remarkable, and "work" undersells it. from my phone i sent: 'use all my chat history to figure out ideas for a long weekend trip with 8 friends, plan the best three options, make a full-stack site where the 9 of us can coordinate on what we would want to do in each place and decide where to go, and then after we get to group agreement make reservations. draft an email in my gmail i can send out to my friends when the site is ready.' it...just worked.

quotes.author: Aaron Levie
quotes.text: There’s still so much opportunity in the diffusion of AI into the real world. Most enterprises are going to need a ton of support to be able to apply the model breakthroughs to their workflows.

summary.zh: 本周提到了 AI 安全性的重要性，尤其是在企业环境中。讨论了如何确保 AI 代理的安全运行，以及用户对 AI 工具的信任问题。
summary.en: This week highlighted the importance of AI security, especially in enterprise environments. Discussions included ensuring the safe operation of AI agents and addressing user trust in AI tools.

quotes.author: Peter Yang
quotes.text: Now that I'm in Canada and talk to folks who don't have AI psychosis the number one concern is not running out of tokens it's 'do I trust ChatGPT enough to share my Gmail, Calendar, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, etc.'

quotes.author: Guillermo Rauch
quotes.text: Kimi's paper underlines the importance of the right security boundary for agents to run in. tl:DR: container-level isolation is not enough. In their experiments, agents crashed the underlying machine (via kernel panics). Firecracker microVMs (as in Vercel Sandbox) are safe.

summary.zh: 本周讨论了 AI 的未来发展，包括新的技术突破、模型能力的提升以及对社会的影响。一些发言者强调了 AI 在科学发现和创新方面的潜力。
summary.en: This week's discussions covered the future of AI, including new technological breakthroughs, increased model capabilities, and their societal impact. Some speakers emphasized the potential of AI in scientific discovery and innovation.

quotes.author: Amjad Masad
quotes.text: We’re entering a new era of exploration. Our ancestors mapped the Earth. Then they explored space. Our generation may explore the computational universe: the vast space of algorithms, programs, proofs, and designs that AI agents can search.

trend.zh: 本周最强的信号是「智能体基建大爆发」：从微软给智能体造可视化语言、Product Hunt 上的智能体数据集市和 iOS 发布流水线，到语音优先的本地编排运行时，一条完整的 agent 供应链正在成形。第二个信号是「AI 反噬经济」的出现——帮人删 AI 烂代码的按周收费服务、清除产品 AI 味的工具、以及黑掉 AI 智能体赢赏金的竞技场，说明 AI 泛滥本身开始养活一批新生意。视频生成的白嫖需求依旧旺盛（Wan2.2 各种镜像霸榜 Hugging Face），而安全侧的提示注入攻击（GitLost 事件）给所有 agent 产品敲了警钟。
trend.en: The loudest signal this week is an agent-infrastructure boom: Microsoft shipped a visualization language for AI agents, Product Hunt surfaced an agent data marketplace and a headless iOS publishing pipeline, and a voice-first local orchestration runtime landed on GitHub — a full agent supply chain is taking shape. The second signal is the rise of an 'AI backlash economy': a $10k-a-week AI-code-deletion service, a tool that strips the 'AI look' from products, and an arena that pays bounties for hacking AI agents all show that AI oversupply is now feeding new businesses. Free video-generation demand stays hot (Wan2.2 mirrors dominate Hugging Face trending), while the GitLost prompt-injection disclosure is a warning shot for every agent product.

deep.zh:
把这 60 个项目摊开看，本周有三条清晰主线。第一条是「智能体基建大爆发」：微软的 Flint 给智能体造可视化表达语言、AgentKey 做智能体数据集市、NoMac.app 做智能体的 iOS 发布流水线、homerail 做语音优先的本地编排、Osaurus 做纯本地 Mac 智能体——从表达层、数据层、发布层到运行时，一条完整的 agent 供应链正在同一周里成形。

第二条是「AI 反噬经济」的抬头：按周收一万美元帮企业删 AI 烂代码的服务、扫描并清除产品「AI 味」的 kill-ai-slop、以及黑掉 AI 智能体赢十万美元赏金的 Playground——AI 泛滥本身开始养活一批逆向生意。

第三条是「生成消费的白热化」：Hugging Face 趋势榜被 Wan2.2 视频生成的各种加速镜像和 Qwen3-TTS、图像编辑器霸占，说明视频/语音/图像生成的免费体验需求远未被满足。安全侧的 GitLost 提示注入事件则给所有 agent 产品敲了警钟。

下周值得盯的是：Flint 这类「智能体表达标准」会不会被跟进、以及本地化 agent（homerail/Osaurus）能不能借隐私焦虑跑出差异化。
deep.en:
Laid out across all 60 projects, three clear storylines run through the week. First, an agent-infrastructure boom: Microsoft's Flint gives agents a visual expression language, AgentKey builds an agent data marketplace, NoMac.app a headless iOS pipeline for agents, homerail a voice-first local orchestrator, Osaurus a fully local Mac agent — expression, data, publishing, and runtime layers of a full agent supply chain all forming in one week. 

Second, the rise of an 'AI backlash economy': a $10k-a-week service to delete AI slop code, kill-ai-slop that scans and strips the 'AI look' from products, and Playground that pays $100k bounties for hacking agents — AI oversupply is now feeding reverse businesses. 

Third, red-hot generative consumption: Hugging Face trending is dominated by Wan2.2 video mirrors, Qwen3-TTS, and image editors, showing free generative demand for video/voice/image is far from saturated. On security, the GitLost prompt-injection incident is a warning shot for every agent product. 

Worth watching next week: whether 'agent expression standards' like Flint get followed, and whether local agents (homerail/Osaurus) can differentiate on privacy anxiety.

overview.zh: 本周大佬圈两种情绪并行：一边是模型厂商之间的火药味——Sam Altman 连发三条夹枪带棒的推文，OpenAI 应用负责人预告 800 万活跃用户里程碑；另一边是 builder 们把智能体推进真实生产的兴奋——云端维护智能体已经开始「打架」，自动调实验的 agent 成为新积木。最硬的数据信号来自 Guillermo Rauch：开源权重模型的网关 token 占比从 4 月的 11% 飙到 29%。同时「绅士科学家时代回归」——用 AI 改电子书固件、边开车边语音写应用，个人黑客文艺复兴正在发生。
overview.en: Two moods ran in parallel among builders this week: model-vendor friction — Sam Altman fired off three pointed tweets while OpenAI's app lead teased an 8M-active-user milestone — and the thrill of pushing agents into real production, where cloud maintainer agents are already 'fighting' and experiment-tuning agents became a new building block. The hardest data point came from Guillermo Rauch: open-weight models now serve 29% of gateway tokens, up from 11% in April. Meanwhile the 'Gentleman Scientist era' is back — AI-hacked e-reader firmware and voice-coding apps while driving mark a personal-hacker renaissance.

title.zh: 模型厂商暗战与里程碑

summary.zh: Sam Altman 本周格外活跃：一边罕见承认「看到我们的模型终于擅长设计，还是有点难以置信」，一边连发两条暗讽竞品的推文（包括那条「我以为是讽刺号，一直在找 c1audeai 的拼写」）。OpenAI 应用负责人 Thibault 则预告 800 万活跃用户庆祝日并发布 ChatGPT Work。头部厂商的竞争已经从发布会打到了时间线上。
summary.en: Sam Altman had an unusually loud week: a rare admission that 'it still sorta breaks my brain to see our models be good at design finally,' plus two pointed jabs at competitors (including the 'kept looking for the handle to be spelled c1audeai' one). OpenAI's app lead Thibault teased an 8M-active-user celebration and ChatGPT Work. Frontier-lab competition has moved from launch events to the timeline.

summary.zh: 智能体不再是 demo：Peter Steinberger 把维护者智能体搬上云端（「它们已经开始打架了」）；Vercel 给智能体开放了 feature flag 实验能力，让网站自我优化；Aaron Levie 给出企业落地模板——前沿模型当管理者、低成本模型干粗活。Swyx 晒出的「大项目工作栈」则展示了多模型分工（规划/评审/编码各司其职）已是资深玩家的日常。
summary.en: Agents are past the demo stage: Peter Steinberger moved maintainer agents to the cloud ('they are fighting already'); Vercel gave agents the power to set up and tune feature-flag experiments toward self-optimizing sites; Aaron Levie sketched the enterprise template — frontier intelligence as manager, cheaper models as workhorses. Swyx's 'Big Boy projects' stack shows multi-model division of labor is now routine for power users.

quotes.author: Aaron Levie

summary.zh: Garry Tan 一句「绅士科学家时代回归了」（1000+ 赞）点破本周最浪漫的趋势：Ryo Lu 用 Cursor 给电子书阅读器写了带中日文竖排排版的自制固件；Nikunj Kothari 边开车边用语音提示词一把梭出报销自动化工具并开源；Amjad Masad 在训练「个人模型」时感叹这就是早期氛围编程的感觉。AI 把硬件黑客和个人软件的门槛打到了地板上。
summary.en: Garry Tan's 'Era of the Gentleman Scientist is so back' (1,000+ likes) named the week's most romantic trend: Ryo Lu shipped custom e-reader firmware with beautiful CJK vertical typography using Cursor; Nikunj Kothari one-shotted an expense-automation tool by voice prompt while driving, then open-sourced it; Amjad Masad said training personal models 'feels like early vibe coding.' AI has floored the barrier to hardware hacking and personal software.

summary.zh: 本周最值得存档的一条数据：Guillermo Rauch 披露开源权重模型在其网关的 token 占比从 4 月的 11% 涨到 29%。结合 Levie 对「前沿模型指挥+廉价模型干活」成本结构的判断，闭源模型的定价压力正在从舆论走向账本——这与本周周报里 GLM 5.2 毛利坍塌的讨论互为印证。
summary.en: The week's most archivable data point: Guillermo Rauch disclosed that open-weight models' share of gateway tokens jumped from 11% in April to 29%. Read alongside Levie's manager/workhorse cost-structure thesis, pricing pressure on closed models is moving from discourse to ledgers — corroborating this week's GLM 5.2 margin-collapse debate in the radar.

quotes.author: Guillermo Rauch
quotes.text: "Open-weight models ran 29% of gateway tokens, up from 11% in April"

quotes.author: Aaron Levie
quotes.text: A few thoughts on what we will see in AI structurally for the foreseeable future: Frontier intelligence continues unabated and pushes the industry forward continuously…

summary.zh: 与本周周报「AI 反噬经济」主线呼应：Peter Yang 公开征讨那些秒回大号的 AI 机器人账号（「每周都要拉黑一批」）；Zara Zhang 分享「不靠 slop 涨粉」的创作心法。当 AI 内容泛滥成为默认状态，「人味」本身正在成为稀缺资产。
summary.en: Echoing this week's 'AI backlash economy' storyline in the radar: Peter Yang called out AI bot accounts that instantly reply to big accounts ('I block a bunch every week'), and Zara Zhang shared how she grows an audience 'without the slop.' As AI content floods becomes the default, humanness itself is turning into the scarce asset.

liftoff.name: gnipbao/story-to-handdrawn-video
liftoff.reason: 把中文故事变成手绘日记风动画视频，这个创意让人想立刻试试。

analysis.zh: story-to-handdrawn-video 将中文故事文案或有序图片转换为手绘日记漫画风格的动画 MP4。656 star 证明了「AI+手绘+视频」组合的大众吸引力，是本周最有趣的创意工具。
analysis.en: story-to-handdrawn-video converts Chinese story copy or ordered images into hand-drawn diary-comic style animation MP4s. 656 stars prove the mass appeal of the 'AI + hand-drawn + video' combination, making it this week's most delightful creative tool.

liftoff.name: bkingfilm/lapian-notes
liftoff.reason: 把电影变成可拆解的拉片笔记：抽帧、剧情泳道、情绪曲线，影迷和影视生的心头好。

analysis.zh: 把电影变成 AI 辅助的拉片笔记：本地抽帧、剧情泳道时间轴、结构树、情绪曲线、段落深拆。影视学习的重度工具，影迷、编剧、影视生的心头好，本地处理也避开了版权雷区。
analysis.en: Turns films into AI-assisted shot-analysis notes: local frame extraction, plot swim-lanes, structure trees, emotion curves, scene breakdowns. A heavy-duty tool for film study — cinephiles, screenwriters, film students — with local processing sidestepping copyright landmines.

liftoff.name: deerwork-ai/deer-workflow
liftoff.reason: 开源图形工程运行时，保持TypeScript编排并将语义工作委托给可替换的代理运行时。

analysis.zh: 该项目是一个开源图形工程运行时，保持TypeScript编排并将语义工作委托给可替换的代理运行时。
analysis.en: This project is an open-source graph engineering runtime that keeps orchestration in TypeScript and delegates semantic work to replaceable agent runtimes.

liftoff.name: hahhforest/pi-textbook
liftoff.reason: 沿 15 个真实 checkpoint 从零构建 Pi-style Agent，学 agent 开发的好教材。

analysis.zh: 《动手学 Pi》是一本交互式教材，通过 15 个真实 checkpoint 教读者从零构建 Pi 风格的 agent。520 star 说明 agent 开发教育有市场，但内容深度有待验证。
analysis.en: 'Hands-on Pi' is an interactive textbook teaching readers to build a Pi-style agent from scratch through 15 real checkpoints. 520 stars indicate a market for agent development education, though content depth remains to be verified.

liftoff.name: xiaotianfotos/homerail
liftoff.reason: 语音优先的本地智能体编排运行时，可审计 DAG 工作流，家庭自动化的正经底座。

analysis.zh: 语音优先的本地智能体编排运行时，把智能体工作流组织成可审计的 DAG，动口不动手地指挥家里的自动化。本地+可审计双卖点踩中隐私焦虑，是 agent 基建里少见的「家用」定位。
analysis.en: A voice-first local agent-orchestration runtime that organizes workflows as auditable DAGs — command your home automation by talking. Local-plus-auditable hits privacy anxiety squarely; a rare 'home-use' position in agent infra.

liftoff.name: AMAP-ML/LongHorizon-Harness
liftoff.reason: 长视野计算机使用套件，支持跨桌面应用程序和CLI长时间运行AI代理。

analysis.zh: LongHorizon-Harness是一个支持AI代理在桌面应用和命令行界面长时间运行的工具，同时保持任务状态和可靠地推进复杂工作流程。
analysis.en: LongHorizon-Harness is a tool that supports AI agents running across desktop apps and the CLI for extended periods, maintaining task state and reliably advancing complex workflows.

liftoff.name: 0xwilliamortiz/andrej-karpathy-skills
liftoff.reason: 从Andrej Karpathy的笔记中提炼出的行为护栏，用于Claude Code。

analysis.zh: 该项目从Andrej Karpathy的笔记中提炼出行为护栏，帮助Claude Code避免常见的错误。
analysis.en: This project distills behavioral guardrails from Andrej Karpathy's field notes to help Claude Code avoid common pitfalls.

liftoff.name: alikon-art/DeterminFlow
liftoff.reason: 面向生产的AI工作流运行时，用于构建、验证和恢复复杂AI工作流。

analysis.zh: DeterminFlow是一个专注于生产环境下的AI工作流管理平台，旨在帮助企业快速开发、测试及部署复杂的AI服务。
analysis.en: DeterminFlow is an AI workflow runtime focused on the production environment, aimed at helping businesses quickly develop, test, and deploy complex AI services.

liftoff.name: gavamedia/deltafin
liftoff.reason: DeltaFin允许在单个设备上运行完整的Kimi K3，并提供OpenAI兼容的API服务器。

analysis.zh: DeltaFin允许在单个设备上运行完整的Kimi K3，并提供OpenAI兼容的API服务器。
analysis.en: DeltaFin allows running full Kimi K3 on a single device and provides an OpenAI-compatible API server.

liftoff.name: Eversmile12/leaked-llm-prompts
liftoff.reason: 各大 LLM 的系统 prompt 泄露合集——窥探 AI 的「潜意识」，吃瓜群众最爱。

analysis.zh: 这是一个收集各大 LLM 泄露系统 prompt 的仓库。243 star 说明人们对 AI 内部指令有强烈好奇心。有研究和教育价值，但法律和伦理边界模糊。
analysis.en: This is a repository collecting leaked system prompts from major LLMs. 243 stars confirm strong public curiosity about AI internal instructions. It has research and educational value, but legal and ethical boundaries are blurry.

liftoff.name: Ayin1412/ForzaHorizon6-VisionAI
liftoff.reason: ForzaHorizon6-VisionAI是一个基于摄像头的闭环驾驶代理，用于Forza Horizon 6游戏。

analysis.zh: ForzaHorizon6-VisionAI是一个基于摄像头的闭环驾驶代理，用于Forza Horizon 6游戏。
analysis.en: ForzaHorizon6-VisionAI is a camera-only closed-loop driving agent for Forza Horizon 6.

liftoff.name: mikehasa/agentacct
liftoff.reason: 给 coding agent 做「工作审计」：read-only 分析日志，零 JS 本地仪表盘。

analysis.zh: agentacct 是一个本地优先的 agent 工作智能工具，只读分析 coding agent 日志，提供使用真相和工作记录。446 star 说明 agent 可观测性是一个真实痛点。
analysis.en: agentacct is a local-first agent work intelligence tool that read-only analyzes coding agent logs, providing usage truth and work records. 446 stars confirm agent observability is a real pain point.

liftoff.name: 0xtresser/Transcript-of-Liang-Wenfengs-DeepSeek-Founder-4-Hour-Investor-Meeting
liftoff.reason: 梁文锋四小时投资人会议实录，提供完整的会议记录。

analysis.zh: 该项目提供了梁文锋四小时投资人会议的完整实录，方便查看和参考。
analysis.en: This project provides a complete transcript of Liang Wenfeng's 4-hour investor meeting, making it easy to view and reference.

liftoff.name: Loki200399/india-itr-copilot
liftoff.reason: India-ITR-Copilot是一个帮助印度所得税申报的辅助工具。

analysis.zh: India-ITR-Copilot是一个帮助印度所得税申报的辅助工具。
analysis.en: India-ITR-Copilot is a tool to assist with Indian income tax return filing.

liftoff.name: thebuggeddev/anatomy
liftoff.reason: 交互式3D人体解剖学探索器，结合GPT实现智能解答。

analysis.zh: 该项目是一个基于Three.js和GPT 5.6构建的交互式3D人体解剖学探索工具，用户可以通过自然语言查询了解人体结构。
analysis.en: This project is an interactive 3D human anatomy explorer built using Three.js and GPT 5.6, allowing users to inquire about the structure of the human body through natural language queries.

liftoff.name: criptogus/HermesOffice
liftoff.reason: 集成原生Hermes Agent AI的办公套件，提升生产力。

analysis.zh: HermesOffice是一款基于GenOffice（Apache-2.0）开发的AI原生办公软件套装，集成了Hermes Agent AI以增强功能。
analysis.en: HermesOffice is an AI-native office suite forked from GenOffice (Apache-2.0), integrated with Hermes Agent AI to enhance its functionalities.

liftoff.name: Invaro/opentax-engine
liftoff.reason: 确定性税务引擎，得分最高记录在TaxCalcBench上。

analysis.zh: Opentax Engine是一个确定性税务引擎，在TaxCalcBench上取得了最高得分记录。
analysis.en: Opentax Engine is a deterministic tax engine that achieved the highest score ever recorded on TaxCalcBench.

liftoff.name: realchendahuang/pi-config
liftoff.reason: Pi-Config提供了一个一键安装和教程README的树莓派编码代理设置。

analysis.zh: Pi-Config提供了一个一键安装和教程README的树莓派编码代理设置。
analysis.en: Pi-Config offers a one-line installer and tutorial README for setting up a Raspberry Pi coding agent.

liftoff.name: 0xwilliamortiz/ponytail-improved
liftoff.reason: Ponytail-Improved让AI代理像最懒的高级开发人员一样思考，追求最少的代码量。

analysis.zh: Ponytail-Improved让AI代理像最懒的高级开发人员一样思考，追求最少的代码量。
analysis.en: Ponytail-Improved makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room, aiming for the least amount of code.

liftoff.name: realfishsam/agent-notch
liftoff.reason: 把 Mac 刘海变成 agent 状态栏——开源版 vibe-island，创意满分。

analysis.zh: agent-notch 是 vibe-island 的开源替代品，将 Mac 刘海区域变成 AI agent 的状态显示区。280 star 说明 Mac 用户对 agent 可视化有需求，但受众有限。
analysis.en: agent-notch is an open-source alternative to vibe-island, turning the Mac notch area into an AI agent status display. 280 stars indicate Mac users want agent visualization, but the audience is limited.

liftoff.name: risa-labs-inc/BossConsole
liftoff.reason: 开源多平台AI代理控制台，集成浏览器、终端、编辑器和100+ MCP工具。

analysis.zh: BossConsole是一个开源多平台AI代理控制台，集成了浏览器、终端、编辑器和100+ MCP工具。
analysis.en: BossConsole is an open-source, multi-platform AI agent console that integrates a real browser, terminal, editor, and 100+ MCP tools.

liftoff.name: yaoleifly/ai-stock-pool
liftoff.reason: AI-Stock-Pool提供了一个AI行业链股票池，支持美股/A股映射、主动发现和一键部署。

analysis.zh: AI-Stock-Pool提供了一个AI行业链股票池，支持美股/A股映射、主动发现和一键部署。
analysis.en: AI-Stock-Pool offers an AI industry-chain stock pool with US/A-share mapping, active discovery, and one-click deployment.

liftoff.name: Binaryify/open-kimi-ppt-skill
liftoff.reason: 让AI代理生成可编辑PPT并附带本地浏览器编辑器，提高工作效率。

analysis.zh: 这是一个非官方的Kimi Slides技能插件，能够通过AI代理生成可编辑的PPT文件，并配备了一个可以在本地运行的浏览器编辑器。
analysis.en: This is an unofficial Kimi Slides skill that allows AI agents to generate editable PPT files, equipped with a local browser editor.

liftoff.name: KORAYTEACHER/fintech-advisor
liftoff.reason: AI 投资组合顾问，赛道有钱但同类拥挤，未见差异化亮点。

analysis.zh: AI 理财顾问，分析你的投资组合并给建议。赛道有钱但极度拥挤，且理财建议有合规红线，项目本身未见差异化亮点。
analysis.en: An AI fintech advisor that analyzes your portfolio and offers suggestions. A moneyed but savagely crowded lane with compliance red lines, and this entry shows no visible differentiation.

liftoff.name: nopnoping/micro-vllm
liftoff.reason: Micro-VLLM是一个小型的教育性质的vLLM实现，用于探索LLM推理、调度和GPU执行。

analysis.zh: Micro-VLLM是一个小型的教育性质的vLLM实现，用于探索LLM推理、调度和GPU执行。
analysis.en: Micro-VLLM is a small, educational vLLM implementation for exploring LLM inference, scheduling, and GPU execution.

liftoff.name: WutIsHummus/TrueDeck
liftoff.reason: TrueDeck提供了一个免费的多代理编码工作台，包含Grok/Codex/Claude/Cursor面板和TrueMemory功能。

analysis.zh: TrueDeck提供了一个免费的多代理编码工作台，包含多个面板和全局内存功能。
analysis.en: TrueDeck offers a free multi-agent coding workbench with Grok/Codex/Claude/Cursor panes and TrueMemory (per-repo + global).

liftoff.name: CWS6206/EasyLastSkill
liftoff.reason: 德语区的近期话题速查智能体技能，功能朴素，受众偏窄。

analysis.zh: 德语区的 Codex/Agent 技能：对某话题检索最近 30 天动态并生成带来源的紧凑报告。功能朴素、受众限定德语用户，是「本地化智能体技能」小趋势的一个样本。
analysis.en: A German-language Codex/Agent skill that researches the last 30 days of a topic and produces a compact sourced report. Modest and German-audience-bound — a specimen of the 'localized agent skills' micro-trend.
